proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed
proposed_widenings.justification: The item uses a hard-coded saving throw DC that is neither caster-derived nor formula-based. The current surface cannot express a fixed item DC honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.magic_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations can specifically require the Magic action, but the current activation cost surface collapses this to a generic action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge...

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The record can only say whether attunement is required, not who is allowed to attune. This item requires attunement specifically by a spellcaster.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wand, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Spellcaster)

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because the core save DC is not representable without lying. The item otherwise matches the existing magic_item activation family: charge pool, repeat save, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction.
